name: Photon energy from wavelength
meaning: Energy of one photon in eV for wavelength λ in nm; visible light (400–700 nm) spans 3.1 to 1.8 eV.

name: Absorption edge
meaning: For band gap Eg in eV, wavelengths shorter than λ_edge (nm) are absorbed and longer ones pass; sets a semiconductor's or pigment's color.

name: Band-gap color rule
latex: E_g \gt 3.1\ \text{eV: colorless}; \quad 1.8 \lt E_g \lt 3.1\ \text{eV: colored}; \quad E_g \lt 1.8\ \text{eV: opaque}
meaning: Compares a pure material's band gap with visible photon energies to predict whether it looks transparent, yellow-to-red, or dark/metallic.

name: Rayleigh scattering
meaning: For scatterers much smaller than the wavelength, scattered intensity rises steeply for shorter wavelengths; 450 nm light scatters about 5.9 times more than 700 nm light.

name: Thin-film extra path
meaning: Extra optical path traveled by light reflected from the back of a film of thickness t and index n (normal incidence); with phase flips it sets which colors are reinforced.

name: Absorbed solar power
meaning: Power absorbed (W) by a surface with absorbed fraction a, in sunlight of intensity I (W/m², about 1000 on a clear day), over area A (m²).
